coordinate_system: Retained F1: x=front inside wall, positive rearward; y=coach centerline; z=rail top. All coordinates here refer to the existing body study, not final suspension mounts.
reference_sections: Retained J1a HSS12x4x1/4 nominal. Grade, delivered section, local reinforcement and welds remain unaccepted.
height_check_limitation: 232.7/182.7mm are datum differences only, not available spring height. Bolster is between axles; a collision exists only where moving volumes overlap. Bearing/seat/guide/frame/center-bearing stack and motion must be resolved in 3D.

mount_load_path.part: Coach body bolster and local reinforcement
mount_load_path.connects: Body main girders to upper center-bearing assembly
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Center-bearing footprint, full truck mass, vertical/longitudinal/lateral/roll loads, local HSS wall/diaphragm and fatigue checks. Do not drill a kingpin hole through an unreinforced tube wall.

mount_load_path.part: Center bearing, retained pivot and sidebearers
mount_load_path.connects: Coach bolster to bogie crossmember; permits yaw and specified pitch/roll
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Vertical load sharing, bearing area/material, pivot shear/bending/retention, sidebearer gap or preload, articulation and wear. A plain bolt is not a complete body support.

mount_load_path.part: Upper spring seats and guide structure
mount_load_path.connects: Bogie side frame to each spring top
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Spring working diameter/end geometry, local plate bending, spring lateral force, guide/brake loads and continuous load path into frame webs.

mount_load_path.connects: Each spring bottom to nonrotating axlebox
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Bearing housing shape and retention, seat offsets, combined vertical/brake moment loads. No welding seats to a rotating axle.

mount_load_path.part: Axlebox guides, wear liners and retention
mount_load_path.connects: Axlebox to bogie frame while permitting designed travel and wheelset articulation
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Lateral/longitudinal force path, permitted angular motion, clearances, replaceable wear surfaces and drop-out retention. Brake reaction must not add a conflicting constraint.

mount_load_path.part: Dampers, bump stops and rebound stops
mount_load_path.connects: Bogie frame to axlebox or assigned sprung member
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Motion ratio, damper force/velocity curve, full travel, angular limits, stop energy and load. Damper must not act as a travel stop unless rated to do so.

mount_load_path.part: Installed D1 brake carrier, cam/chamber supports and hoses
mount_load_path.connects: Nonrotating axlebox/carrier to brake torque path and frame air supply
mount_load_path.definition_needed: Actual OEM envelope and interfaces; full suspension travel, yaw and service-removal clearance. Retain drum/hub extraction as one unit.
